designationHistory.indexText: Rose Atoll was made a national wildlife refuge on July 15, 1973, by a cooperative agreement between the Government of American Samoa and the Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife.

authority.citation: Cooperative agreement with the Government of American Samoa

designationHistory.note: All sources found are FWS-authored: fws.gov gives July 15, 1973; the 2009 Federal Register notice says established in 1973 after a cooperative agreement; a 1974 Interior news release announced it. No American Samoa government or other independent record was found. Separately, President George W. Bush's Proclamation 8337 of January 6, 2009 made the atoll a marine national monument.
